item.title: The mourning show: the politics of Khamenei’s funeral
item.description: "Explore the intricacies of Iranian politics as we dissect the implications of Ayatollah Khamenei's passing. Tune in to 'The Mourning Show' for expert analysis on the power struggle, succession, and global repercussions surrounding the Supreme Leader's funeral."
